Cleric.title: Restless Crypt
Cleric.text: The crypt door yawns open and dead hands scrape against stone.

Cleric.title: Bone Chapel
Cleric.text: Skeletons rise among the shattered pews of a burial chapel.

Cleric.title: Grave Watch
Cleric.text: Restless dead move between leaning grave markers.

Cleric.title: Catacomb Procession
Cleric.text: A procession of the dead blocks the narrow catacomb passage.

Cleric.title: Desecrated Tomb
Cleric.text: The corpse within a broken tomb lurches upright.

Cleric.title: Ashen Ossuary
Cleric.text: Dry bones knit themselves together around the ossuary.

Cleric.title: Sunken Mausoleum
Cleric.text: Dead guardians climb from black water around a sunken mausoleum.

Cleric.title: Bell-Tower Dead
Cleric.text: A dead bell-keeper descends the ruined tower stairs.

Cleric.title: Sepulchral Guard
Cleric.text: Ancient corpses stand between you and the inner sepulchre.

Cleric.title: Necropolis Gate
Cleric.text: The dead gather beneath the cracked arch of the necropolis.

Cleric.title: Sealed Ossuary
Cleric.text: Sacred markings cover a sealed ossuary. Something about them feels wrong.

Cleric.title: Broken Shrine
Cleric.text: A neglected shrine has been deliberately defaced.

Cleric.title: Funeral Bell
Cleric.text: A bell rings somewhere beneath the earth although no living hand pulls its rope.

Cleric.title: Forbidden Reliquary
Cleric.text: A reliquary has been forced open and its wards disturbed.

Cleric.title: Pilgrim's Warning
Cleric.text: A frightened pilgrim insists the burial road is cursed.

Cleric.title: Black Candles
Cleric.text: Black candles burn before an empty tomb without melting.

Cleric.title: Unquiet Grave
Cleric.text: Fresh soil moves on a grave that has stood for generations.

Cleric.title: Chapel Threshold
Cleric.text: A cold pressure hangs across the chapel threshold.

Cleric.title: Nameless Sarcophagus
Cleric.text: Every name has been chiselled from an ancient sarcophagus.

Cleric.title: Whispering Vault
Cleric.text: Whispers answer every prayer spoken near a sealed vault.

Cleric.title: Saint's Niche
Cleric.text: A hidden niche contains an old devotional token.

Cleric.title: Catacomb Map
Cleric.text: Faded devotional marks form a map of forgotten passages.

Cleric.title: Consecrated Spring
Cleric.text: Clear water gathers beneath a weathered sacred carving.

Cleric.title: Burial Ledger
Cleric.text: A stone ledger records generations of forgotten burials.

Cleric.title: Ancient Epitaph
Cleric.text: An inscription records why this crypt was sealed.

Cleric.title: Reliquary Fragment
Cleric.text: A fragment of a small reliquary lies beneath fallen masonry.

Cleric.title: Votive Chamber
Cleric.text: Hundreds of tiny offerings cover a chamber wall.

Cleric.title: Saint Ordel's Mark
Cleric.text: An unfamiliar carved symbol resembles accounts of Saint Ordel.

Cleric.title: Processional Mosaic
Cleric.text: A damaged mosaic depicts an old funerary procession.

Cleric.title: Hidden Vestry
Cleric.text: A concealed vestry holds mouldering vestments and records.

Cleric.title: Silent Nave
Cleric.text: Only dust moves through the ruined chapel.

Cleric.title: Candle Alcove
Cleric.text: An abandoned candle alcove offers a sheltered pause.

Cleric.title: Old Cemetery
Cleric.text: The cemetery lies quiet beneath the grey sky.

Cleric.title: Crypt Landing
Cleric.text: Nothing stirs on the broad stone landing.

Cleric.title: Monastery Ruin
Cleric.text: Wind passes through the empty cloister.

Cleric.title: Wayside Shrine
Cleric.text: A small roadside shrine remains undisturbed.

Cleric.title: Stone Cloister
Cleric.text: Rain taps softly against the old cloister roof.

Cleric.title: Pilgrim Steps
Cleric.text: Worn steps offer a place to rest before the climb.

Cleric.title: Memorial Garden
Cleric.text: Dead leaves gather around weathered memorial stones.

Cleric.title: Dawn Chapel
Cleric.text: Pale morning light enters through a roofless chapel.

Thief.title: Warehouse Patrol
Thief.text: Lantern-bearing guards round the warehouse corner.

Thief.title: Rooftop Pursuit
Thief.text: Boots hammer across the tiles behind you.

Thief.title: Back-Alley Watch
Thief.text: A pair of watchmen blocks the narrow alley.

Thief.title: Guild Enforcers
Thief.text: Two hard-looking figures step from a doorway.

Thief.title: Manor Guard
Thief.text: A guard appears at the end of the gallery.

Thief.title: Locked Counting House
Thief.text: A side door to a counting house has a difficult lock.

Thief.title: Open Window
Thief.text: An upper window has been left slightly open.

Thief.title: Guard Rotation
Thief.text: The patrol leaves a brief gap near the courtyard wall.

Thief.title: Merchant's Ledger
Thief.text: An unattended ledger could reveal something valuable.

Thief.title: Narrow Escape
Thief.text: Two routes lead away from the scene: rooftops or sewers.

Thief.title: Hidden Purse
Thief.text: A purse has been tucked beneath a loose brick.

Thief.title: Smuggler Mark
Thief.text: A discreet symbol marks a cellar entrance.

Thief.title: Forgotten Key
Thief.text: A small iron key lies behind a rain barrel.

Thief.title: Fence's Cache
Thief.text: A concealed compartment holds trade goods.

Thief.title: Secret Passage
Thief.text: A disguised panel opens into a service corridor.

Thief.title: Sleeping Street
Thief.text: The district lies quiet under shuttered windows.

Thief.title: Empty Rooftop
Thief.text: No one looks up as you cross the roofs.

Thief.title: Market After Dark
Thief.text: The stalls are closed and the square is empty.

Thief.title: Abandoned Loft
Thief.text: A dusty loft offers a safe pause.

Thief.title: Canal Walk
Thief.text: Only black water moves beside the silent warehouses.

Arcanist.title: Tower Familiar
Arcanist.text: A hostile magical creature circles the stair of an abandoned arcane tower.

Arcanist.title: Unstable Summoning
Arcanist.text: A summoned creature strains against a failing containment circle.

Arcanist.title: Arcane Sentinel
Arcanist.text: An enchanted guardian wakes beside a sealed laboratory.

Arcanist.title: Rift Creature
Arcanist.text: Something clawed crawls through a dimensional tear.

Arcanist.title: Living Spell
Arcanist.text: Loose magic condenses into a violent, shifting form.

Arcanist.title: Glass Golem
Arcanist.text: A crystalline guardian steps from a shattered display chamber.

Arcanist.title: Aether Parasite
Arcanist.text: A pale creature feeds on the glow of an arcane conduit.

Arcanist.title: Mirror Double
Arcanist.text: A hostile reflection steps free of a black mirror.

Arcanist.title: Runic Guardian
Arcanist.text: A rune-carved construct blocks the archive stairs.

Arcanist.title: Portal Hunter
Arcanist.text: A strange predator emerges from a portal and fixes on you.

Arcanist.title: Dimensional Door
Arcanist.text: A thin doorway opens onto impossible stars.

Arcanist.title: Runed Observatory
Arcanist.text: The observatory controls are covered in shifting runes.

Arcanist.title: Broken Portal
Arcanist.text: A damaged portal flickers between unknown destinations.

Arcanist.title: Forbidden Formula
Arcanist.text: An unfinished formula covers an entire wall.

Arcanist.title: Mirror Passage
Arcanist.text: A black mirror reflects a corridor that is not here.

Arcanist.title: Clockwork Orrery
Arcanist.text: A brass model of unknown worlds turns by itself.

Arcanist.title: Arcane Lock
Arcanist.text: A door is sealed by interlocking magical symbols.

Arcanist.title: Gravity Well
Arcanist.text: Loose stones hang motionless above a dark stair.

Arcanist.title: Memory Prism
Arcanist.text: A prism projects fragments of another scholar's memories.

Arcanist.title: Shifting Library
Arcanist.text: Shelves rearrange whenever you stop looking at them.

Arcanist.title: Spell Fragment
Arcanist.text: A surviving page contains a fragment of arcane notation.

Arcanist.title: Aether Crystal
Arcanist.text: A humming crystal rests in a brass cradle.

Arcanist.title: Tower Archive
Arcanist.text: A sealed cabinet preserves old magical records.

Arcanist.title: Planar Residue
Arcanist.text: Strange residue marks where another dimension touched this one.

Arcanist.title: Astral Lens
Arcanist.text: A cracked lens still reveals distant lights.

Arcanist.title: Sealed Thesis
Arcanist.text: A metal tube protects a forgotten magical thesis.

Arcanist.title: Portal Coordinates
Arcanist.text: A slate records a sequence of impossible coordinates.

Arcanist.title: Failed Homunculus
Arcanist.text: Notes beside an inert construct document a failed experiment.

Arcanist.title: Star Map
Arcanist.text: A ceiling chart shows constellations that do not belong to this sky.

Arcanist.title: Ciphered Grimoire
Arcanist.text: A damaged book is written in a dense arcane cipher.

Arcanist.title: Empty Laboratory
Arcanist.text: Cold burners and dusty glassware fill the silent room.

Arcanist.title: Tower Balcony
Arcanist.text: The ruined tower offers a clear view of the land below.

Arcanist.title: Dormant Circle
Arcanist.text: An old summoning circle lies cold and inactive.

Arcanist.title: Dusty Archive
Arcanist.text: Nothing moves among the shelves but drifting dust.

Arcanist.title: Observatory Dome
Arcanist.text: The great dome stands open beneath the night sky.

Arcanist.title: Scribe's Chamber
Arcanist.text: Dry ink pots and blank parchment remain on a scholar's desk.

Arcanist.title: Quiet Portal Hall
Arcanist.text: Every portal frame is dark and still.

Arcanist.title: Abandoned Lecture Room
Arcanist.text: Rows of stone benches face a cracked slate.

Arcanist.title: Aether Garden
Arcanist.text: Harmless motes of light drift through a glass-roofed chamber.

Arcanist.title: Silent Study
Arcanist.text: A heavy desk and extinguished lamp offer a safe pause.

Dwarf.title: Mine Tunnel Ambush
Dwarf.text: Movement breaks the darkness in an abandoned mine tunnel.

Dwarf.title: Cavern Predator
Dwarf.text: A subterranean predator emerges between the rocks.

Dwarf.title: Collapsed Gallery
Dwarf.text: Something waits beyond a recently collapsed mining gallery.

Dwarf.title: Deep Delvers
Dwarf.text: Hostile figures appear farther down the tunnel.

Dwarf.title: Underground Nest
Dwarf.text: A nest blocks the narrow cave passage.

Dwarf.title: Mushroom Cavern
Dwarf.text: A creature crashes through a forest of giant cave fungi.

Dwarf.title: Old Guard Post
Dwarf.text: Hostile squatters occupy a forgotten underground guard post.

Dwarf.title: Deep Chasm
Dwarf.text: Something climbs from a chasm beside the trail.

Dwarf.title: Ore Cart Ambush
Dwarf.text: An abandoned ore cart hides movement in the dark.

Dwarf.title: Buried Hall
Dwarf.text: A beast has made its lair inside an ancestral stone hall.

Dwarf.title: Forked Mine
Dwarf.text: The old mine splits into a worked tunnel and a natural cave.

Dwarf.title: Unstable Supports
Dwarf.text: Rotten timbers hold up the passage ahead.

Dwarf.title: Flooded Shaft
Dwarf.text: A mine shaft descends into black water.

Dwarf.title: Ore Vein
Dwarf.text: A promising vein disappears behind fractured stone.

Dwarf.title: Sealed Deep Door
Dwarf.text: A heavy stone door closes an ancient tunnel.

Dwarf.title: False Wall
Dwarf.text: One stretch of rock looks subtly different from the rest.

Dwarf.title: Ancient Lift
Dwarf.text: A counterweighted mining lift hangs over a deep shaft.

Dwarf.title: Fault Line
Dwarf.text: A fresh crack runs across the cavern roof.

Dwarf.title: Ventilation Shaft
Dwarf.text: A narrow shaft carries warm air from somewhere below.

Dwarf.title: Lost Hold Gate
Dwarf.text: An immense gate bears weathered clan marks.

Dwarf.title: Forgotten Tools
Dwarf.text: Old mining tools remain where their owners left them.

Dwarf.title: Miner's Cache
Dwarf.text: A hidden niche contains a miner's emergency cache.

Dwarf.title: Crystal Cavern
Dwarf.text: Natural crystals glitter across the cavern walls.

Dwarf.title: Old Survey Marks
Dwarf.text: Chiselled marks reveal the mine's forgotten layout.

Dwarf.title: Buried Strongbox
Dwarf.text: A battered strongbox protrudes from a cave-in.

Dwarf.title: Ancestral Carving
Dwarf.text: A wall carving records names from a forgotten dwarf line.

Dwarf.title: Worked Seam
Dwarf.text: Tool marks reveal where miners followed a vanished ore seam.

Dwarf.title: Stone Cistern
Dwarf.text: A carefully built cistern still collects clean cave water.

Dwarf.title: Rune Fragment
Dwarf.text: A broken stone bears part of an old family rune.

Dwarf.title: Foundation Stone
Dwarf.text: A massive dressed stone carries the mason's original mark.

Dwarf.title: Dry Cavern
Dwarf.text: A broad dry cavern offers a safe place to pause.

Dwarf.title: Old Mine Office
Dwarf.text: A stone desk stands untouched in a forgotten mine office.

Dwarf.title: Deep Hearth
Dwarf.text: A cold hearth remains in an abandoned underground hall.

Dwarf.title: Echo Chamber
Dwarf.text: Only the sound of dripping water crosses the cavern.

Dwarf.title: Tool Alcove
Dwarf.text: An empty tool alcove provides shelter from the tunnel.

Dwarf.title: Stone Bridge
Dwarf.text: An old bridge spans a silent underground stream.

Dwarf.title: Abandoned Forge
Dwarf.text: The forge is cold, but its stonework remains sound.

Dwarf.title: Survey Chamber
Dwarf.text: Faded maps cover the walls of an otherwise empty room.

Dwarf.title: Deep Well
Dwarf.text: A covered well stands beside a quiet passage.

Dwarf.title: Ancestral Hall
Dwarf.text: Rows of worn stone pillars disappear into the darkness.

Elf.title: Forest Stalker
Elf.text: Something follows silently between the trees.

Elf.title: Ruined Grove
Elf.text: Hostile movement disturbs an ancient grove.

Elf.title: Woodland Ambush
Elf.text: Shapes shift among the ferns beside the trail.

Elf.title: Riverbank Predator
Elf.text: A predator emerges near the forest river.

Elf.title: Overgrown Ruin
Elf.text: Something has made its lair in a vine-covered ruin.

Elf.title: Blighted Clearing
Elf.text: A hostile creature prowls a clearing where the plants have blackened.

Elf.title: Canopy Hunter
Elf.text: Branches shake overhead as a predator follows from tree to tree.

Elf.title: Poacher Camp
Elf.text: Armed intruders guard traps set along an animal trail.

Elf.title: Root-Cave Lair
Elf.text: A beast bursts from beneath the roots of an ancient tree.

Elf.title: Thorn Hollow
Elf.text: Something dangerous moves inside a dense hollow of thorns.

Elf.title: Hidden Trail
Elf.text: A barely visible trail leaves the main woodland path.

Elf.title: Ancient Grove
Elf.text: Old trees encircle a place untouched by axes.

Elf.title: River Crossing
Elf.text: The forest river runs fast after recent rain.

Elf.title: Fallen Oak
Elf.text: A gigantic fallen oak conceals a hollow beneath its roots.

Elf.title: Moonlit Stones
Elf.text: Standing stones glow faintly in a moonlit clearing.

Elf.title: Storm-Damaged Path
Elf.text: Windfall has erased the trail ahead.

Elf.title: Wounded Stag
Elf.text: A wounded stag watches from beneath the trees.

Elf.title: Withered Copse
Elf.text: A small stand of trees has withered without obvious cause.

Elf.title: Forked Game Trail
Elf.text: Two animal trails split around a wooded ridge.

Elf.title: Encroaching Bramble
Elf.text: An unnatural wall of bramble chokes an old woodland route.

Elf.title: Herbal Clearing
Elf.text: Useful herbs grow in a sheltered clearing.

Elf.title: Hunter's Marker
Elf.text: An old woodland marker points toward a forgotten route.

Elf.title: Forest Spring
Elf.text: Clear water rises between moss-covered stones.

Elf.title: Overgrown Shrine
Elf.text: Roots curl around a small forgotten shrine.

Elf.title: Ancient Tree
Elf.text: Carvings on an immense tree record an old journey.

Elf.title: Rare Seedpod
Elf.text: An unfamiliar seedpod hangs from a single old branch.

Elf.title: Animal Crossing
Elf.text: Tracks from many species converge at one narrow place.

Elf.title: Old Boundary Oak
Elf.text: Faint cuts in an oak mark an ancient forest boundary.

Elf.title: Hidden Orchard
Elf.text: Wild descendants of an old orchard grow deep in the forest.

Elf.title: Burned Glade
Elf.text: New green shoots rise through the remains of an old fire.

Elf.title: Green Canopy
Elf.text: Sunlight filters peacefully through the leaves.

Elf.title: Forest Pool
Elf.text: A still pool reflects the branches above.

Elf.title: Mossy Hollow
Elf.text: Soft moss covers a sheltered hollow between roots.

Elf.title: Old Oak
Elf.text: An immense oak offers shade and a dry place to rest.

Elf.title: Fern Clearing
Elf.text: Nothing stirs beyond insects among the ferns.

Elf.title: Willow Bank
Elf.text: Willows hang over a slow, quiet stream.

Elf.title: Pine Ridge
Elf.text: Wind moves softly through high pine branches.

Elf.title: Deer Meadow
Elf.text: A small meadow lies undisturbed between the woods.

Elf.title: Rain Shelter
Elf.text: Dense branches keep the forest floor almost dry.

Elf.title: Dawn Grove
Elf.text: Morning light slowly reaches the floor of an ancient grove.
